posts.t: Hey guys... I know I haven't posted in a while. I've had some personal issues I had to deal with over the past few weeks. I found out as of April 1st my federal job will be contacted out, and I will be forced to take a 30% paycut. I've been pretty stressed out and trying to get things taken care of, as I have a family to take care of. I was able to find a part time job to make up the difference. I'm now ready to resume my training.
